newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil eases, Nov IPE play again curbs volume.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil eases, Nov IPE play again curbs volume.

text.p: NWE gas oil premiums were unchanged to slightly softer on Monday with volumes again overshadowed by a 10-day old standoff over a record high November IPE delivery, traders said.
"The whole market, both barges and cargoes, is affected (by the dispute). We're waiting to see which way it's going to be resolved," one trader said.

The IPE play involving over 600,000 tonnes still absorbs most barge capacity in the Rotterdam region. Trading house AIC, the dominant Nov short, said Cargill, the main long, did not take full delivery or make adequate nominations.
Cargill has said there have been some problems but has added it was confident of resolving these.
Prices eased with benchmark Dec IPE futures, which were down $0.50 at $222.25 in thin and featureless trade.
Low sulphur diesel barges were discussed around $1.50 lower at Dec IPE +$10.50/12.50. Heating oil barges were slightly softer at Dec IPE +$2/3 for late November and early December.
German quality 0.2 percent sulphur heating oil cargoes were discussed at Dec IPE +$2/3 for December 1-10, slightly down. Low sulphur diesel cargoes were steady at Dec IPE +$16/19.
